system.description:
The fencing salles of Eltor, the duelling courts of Opal and any city where honour is settled with a blade. Precision over power.

  • Riposte Step: when a creature misses you with a melee attack, your next hit against it before the end of your next turn deals an extra weapon damage die.
    • 9th level: Riposte Step also triggers when a creature misses an ally within your reach.
  • Connoisseur: Advantage on checks to identify, appraise or recall lore about fine weapons and famous duellists.
